changes.summary: Wiki templates reframed to present the wiki as a project's institutional memory (decisions, process, external memory), not just a doc dump
uncertainty: This is a CLI/markdown plugin with no analytics instrumentation and no signals/tracking-plan.yaml — events_touched is empty by nature for every change here; this is not tracking-plan drift.

changes.summary: Scaffolding UX overhaul — the wiki now lands in a clean <project>-wiki/ container (no more nested wiki/wiki/), opens directly in Obsidian, and offers opt-in ingest of existing docs
uncertainty: Mixes feat (new container UX) and fix (removing wiki/wiki nesting, container-path refs) commits; classified feature by net user impact.

changes.summary: /team offers to add the standard citation anchor inline instead of hard-refusing to spawn a persona that lacks one
/staff distinguishes a new-project cold start from expanding an existing project's team, so it no longer assumes the factory-home roster is the team
Wiki scaffolding registers the vault in obsidian.json before opening it, fixing the first-open 'Vault not found' error
/team presents an explicit fork (run existing team / build a whole team via /staff / hire one individual / custom) instead of funneling every request into a single-persona recruit
/staff profiles every proposed team member before asking for approval, so the user sees who each hire is rather than a bare list of names

Team-reporting overhaul — personas report on a fixed five-part contract, the orchestrator synthesizes answer-first and concrete (recommendation + specifics, not a wall of takes), and a schema-enforced validate-report gate plus per-question effort scaling right-size and validate each run
uncertainty: Feature iterated across five releases (v0.3.5-v0.3.10) including a bottom_line budget calibration fix (v0.3.8) folded in here as part of the same feature.

changes.summary: Skill preflight checks the resolved plugin path instead of a phantom CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT env var (which is a text placeholder, not a shell variable), fixing a spurious 'not set' hard-fail across all 17 skills

Skill-chaining audit — every skill that files into the wiki now uses one uniform --auto --wiki ingest contract, analyze and critique now compound (were writing orphaned digests), the wiki router covers all 17 skills, and wiki-lint's Obsidian setup registers the vault
uncertainty: Surfaces derived largely from the detailed commit subjects plus partial diffs; several SKILL.md diffs exceeded the collector's diff budget (12 skipped paths across the range), so the per-file evidence is incomplete.

changes.summary: Corrected the plugin listing and README — 17 skills (was mislabeled 16) and /staff now documented in the factory subsystem
uncertainty: Docs-only; no runtime behavior change (the type enum has no 'docs' value, classified fix as the closest match).
